result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, 0 failures). Nothing is committed.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`listStockByWarehouse`): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the other stock overviews use. `getQuantity` is unchanged, so a product with no stock still reports 0.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all the nuts out of WH-1 and sets the screw count to 0, then checks that the WH-1 list shows only "Bolt 10" and that the nut quantity is still 0.
